notes: TNRERA's own registered-projects listing page currently disallows automated access under its robots.txt, so this registration number is reported by multiple independent sites, not confirmed directly at the regulator. The regulator's own homepage remains readable.

findings.claim: Registered with TNRERA as TN/35/Building/0097/2025, dated 2 April 2025.
The project totals 1,314 units across 21.87 acres.

The developer is Casagrand Premier Builder Limited. Its company number matches Casagrand Builder Private Limited's (U70101TN2003PTC051989) except for the private/public marker — one company, later converted to a public company.
Three listing sites give possession as August 2028.
Promotional pages say Casagrand completes over 90% of its projects on time. This is marketing, not independent evidence, and does not move the score.
A construction contractor's portfolio lists several Casagrand apartment projects in Chennai, including Crescendo and Zenith, as completed.

Tamil Nadu's regulator and its appellate tribunal have penalised Casagrand Builder Private Limited for misrepresentation more than once: in 2020 it cancelled the Bloom project's registration with a ₹30 lakh fine (the developer denied the charges); in 2022 the tribunal raised a penalty over Casagrand Crescendo's advertising to ₹25 lakh, noting earlier similar violations.
Casagrand's own website still lists Bloom with its regulator registration numbers in 2026. Whether the 2020 cancellation was later overturned on appeal was not found in any source checked.

In September 2026 Tamil Nadu's regulator ordered delay interest on a villa in Casagrand Divinity (developer entity Casa Grande Smart Values Homes): a December 2023 handover promised by email was missed until April 2026.
In a 2025 petition to the regulator, buyers in Casagrand Utopia say handover is years past its May 2023 deadline despite extensions.

conflicts.topic: Possession date — a five-year spread for the same RERA-numbered project

reading.observation: Six independent listing sites give six different possession dates — March 2027 to March 2032 — for the exact same RERA-numbered project. No source explains the spread; each states its own date as fact.
reading.question: Which possession date is actually printed on the TNRERA registration certificate itself?

reading.observation: The two company names in listings — Casagrand Builder Private Limited and Casagrand Premier Builder Limited — share one company number apart from the private/public marker: the same company, converted to a public company. That resolves the question; the name on your agreement should be the current one.

questions.question: Please show me the TNRERA registration certificate for TN/35/Building/0097/2025 — which possession date does it show?

questions.red_flag: A verbal date with no certificate shown.

questions.question: Which bank holds the project's RERA escrow account, and can I see a stamped statement from the last 90 days?
questions.good: A named bank and a dated, stamped statement.
questions.red_flag: Any account in a name other than the registered promoter.
